Construct a 3D geometry packet

Source: R/scene-contract.R
new_scene_packet.Rd

Emitters registered with register_geom_3d() return a validated scene packet. Each geometry table is a named list of equal-length numeric vectors. Indices start at one. Empty lists represent unused geometry kinds.

Usage

new_scene_packet(
  vertices = list(),
  corners = list(),
  faces = list(),
  polylines = list(),
  markers = list(),
  text = list(),
  footprints = list(),
  footprint_vertices = list(),
  styles = data.frame(style_id = integer()),
  panel_id = 1L,
  quadrics = list()
)

Arguments

vertices

List with x, y, z and optional w: homogeneous positions in normalised panel coordinates, see normalise_homogeneous_3d(). w defaults to 1, must be nonnegative, and w = 0 places an ideal point (a direction) at infinity. Geometry through an ideal point is clipped by the panel box, the near and far planes or the viewport before it is drawn.

corners

List with vertex indices and source_row input indices, and optional per-corner attributes normal_x, normal_y, normal_z, red, green, blue, alpha (encoded sRGB colour channels in [0, 1], interpolated in linear light) and u, v (texture coordinates), in that order; NA marks a corner without the attribute. Compiled vertex weights carry them through clipping.

faces, polylines, markers, text

Primitive tables. Each requires offset into corners. Faces default to three corners, polylines to two, and markers and text to one. Common columns include count, primitive_id, layer_id, source_row, style_id, role, partition and opacity. Markers also require footprint_id. Text sizes use width_mm and height_mm. Polylines take an optional mask_width_mm, at least width_mm and by default equal to it: the width of the band in which the line hides what lies behind it, while the line itself is drawn at width_mm (a haloed line, Appel 1967).

footprints

Marker shapes: kind (1 for ellipse, 2 for polygon), offset, count, radius_x_mm, radius_y_mm and angle.

footprint_vertices

Polygon footprint coordinates x_mm, y_mm and ring.

styles

Data frame with contiguous integer style_id keys, fill, colour and other rendering properties. Face lighting uses shade and optional normal_x, normal_y, normal_z in normalised panel coordinates. An optional integer texture_id (NA for none) names a texture held on the R side.

panel_id

Positive integer panel identifier.

quadrics

Analytic primitives: kind (1 sphere, 2 cylinder, 3 cone), centre_x, centre_y, centre_z, the unit axis axis_x, axis_y, axis_z (default the z axis), radius_a, radius_b (cone end radius, default 0) and length, with the common primitive_id, layer_id, source_row, style_id, partition and opacity columns.

Value

A validated ggplot3d_scene_packet containing geometry and styles.

Examples

new_scene_packet()
# A triangle with one corner at infinity in the x direction.
new_scene_packet(
  vertices = list(x = c(0.2, 0.2, 1), y = c(0.2, 0.8, 0), z = c(0.5, 0.5, 0),
                  w = c(1, 1, 0)),
  corners = list(vertex = 1:3),
  faces = list(offset = 1L),
  styles = data.frame(style_id = 1L, fill = "grey60"))
